previous.text: Rotate an API key: create the replacement, deploy it, then revoke the old key.
List calls need the read scope.
A lost key cannot be recovered. Create a replacement and revoke the lost one.
Invoices are under Billing, one PDF per month.
The write scope adds create and delete.
